purpose: Filled permit application worksheets for the Baltimore City DHCD ePermits new-construction path, mirroring the portal screens so values can be transcribed directly.
scopeBoundary: Baltimore City accepts these applications only through the ePermits portal; no standalone fillable PDFs exist for this path. Every value the model can supply is filled in; fields marked for the owner or a licensed professional are genuinely theirs to complete and none of this is a submitted application or approval.
